column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV reorders, “he who honors Him has mercy on the needy,” where the Hebrew is “one who is gracious to the needy honors Him.”
Close to the Hebrew; יִדָּחֶה (“is thrust down”) is rendered “is banished.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in the inward part of fools it is made known” is rendered “what is in the heart of fools is made known.”
